text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day we make Fuji marvelous, 
since she's always giving us 
marvelousness☆★☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Sooo... Mayano and I are gonna take Fuji 
on a sparkly and marvelous birthday tour☆★

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Such a wonderful present, I'm so happy! 
Fufufufu, where on earth are you taking 
me, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's~☆★☆ a surprise for after we 
Marvelous!★☆★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Because if we told you, Fuji-senpai, you'd 
just jump ahead and try to turn it around 
to entertain Maya and the others instead, 
wouldn't you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, it's just... I was curious! —Come on, 
please? Not even a little?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No way☆ Today it's Maya and the crew's 
turn to entertain! Fuji-senpai, you're 
banned from entertainer duty!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oops, if you put it that way... I'll take 
you up on your offer and take a special 
day off today.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
For today only, I am 'just Fuji Kiseki.' I 
place myself entirely in both of your 
hands—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ Then let's keep going on this 
sparkling and marvelous tour――
